messages.author: ec88b267f31e05d3
messages.subject: Error in plot function
parts:
Hi All,

I have a simple Markov model defined as:

library(tidyverse)
library(blavaan)

lg <- read.csv("PrmLg17_18.csv", header = TRUE, row.names = 1)

mm <- '
Week4 ~ Week1
Week8 ~ Week4
Week11 ~ Week8
Week15 ~ Week11
Week22 ~ Week15
Week26 ~ Week22
Week29 ~ Week26
Week33 ~ Week29
Week37 ~ Week33
Week38 ~ Week37'

a <- bsem(mm, data = lg, n.chains = 4, bcontrol = list(cores = parallel::detectCores()))

plot(a, pars= 1:4, plot.type="autocorr") #Autocorrelation plots

plot(a, pars= 1:4, plot.type="ecdf") #ECDF plots

plot(a, pars= 1:4, plot.type="density") #Density plots


#PS: I am using stan, and anytime I try to run these plot functions, I get an error, usually
> plot(a, pars= 1:4, plot.type="autocorr") #Autocorrelation plots
Error in .local(x, ...) : Plotting function not found.

The plot function only seem to work for:
plot(a, pars= 1:4, plot.type="trace") #Traceplots

I'll be glad if you can help

Thanks,
John

messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: Re: Error in plot function
parts:
John,

The plot.type options differ between jags and stan, because the
blavaan plot command is just a wrapper around the runjags and rstan
plot commands. For stan, the plot.type can be any word after the "_"
in this list of options:

http://mc-stan.org/rstan/reference/plotting-functions.html

e.g., "plot", "trace", "hist", etc

Ed

Another issue is the use of blavFitIndices
> fitMeasures(a)
Error in solve.default(tmp) : 
  Lapack routine dgesv: system is exactly singular: U[1,1] = 0
> blavFitIndices(a)
Error in solve.default(tmp) : 
  Lapack routine dgesv: system is exactly singular: U[1,1] = 0

I can't tell if it's due to my model because I'm able to generate posterior predictives.


Thanks very much,
John

model/data that you sent in the previous email. But I did not try to
load the tidyverse, so maybe try it without tidyverse. If that doesn't
work, make sure you have the latest version of blavaan on CRAN (0.3-3)
and then send your sessionInfo().

Ed
